concerns.text: Task T006.1-Stream implements streaming from 'coco_2017' dataset, but Spec FR-001 and US-1 explicitly mandate downloading from the 'Visual Genome' dataset. This is a silent relaxation of the data source requirement, violating the Single Source of Truth (Constitution IV) and FR-001.

Task T035 implements a standard 'One-Way ANOVA' (between-groups), but Spec FR-005 and US-3 explicitly require a 'repeated-measures ANOVA' (within-subjects). This is a fundamental methodological weakening of the statistical requirement, invalidating the analysis plan.

Task T027.2 allows generating a 'partial set' (min 8 items) and flagging sessions as incomplete if the false lure pool is sparse. Spec US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 and FR-004 require a 'balanced set' of 20 questions (10 true, 10 false). The task silently relaxes the acceptance criterion by allowing incomplete sessions to proceed without the full required set.

Task T012 calculates power and halts the pipeline if N < 50. Spec SC-002 requires calculating power *before* data collection to determine the *planned* sample size. The task logic creates a deadlock where the project cannot proceed to collect the required 50 sessions if the calculation yields <50, rather than using the calculation to set the target N.

Task T015 depends on T015.1-Run to generate 'minor object PNG assets'. However, the 'Rejected Tasks' section (implied by context or previous iteration notes) indicates the asset generation artifact is missing/invalid. Without a valid task to generate these assets, the implementation of the image manipulation pipeline (US-1) is blocked, violating the requirement to create manipulated versions.
